results.title: Mumbai Crime Branch invokes MCOCA against all accused in Tiger Shroff case
results.content: Crime Branch obtained approval from the competent authority under Section 23(1)(a) of MCOCA on October 27

results.title: Rajnath raises U.S. F-16 package for Pakistan, cross-border terrorism with Hegseth
results.content: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh conveyed India’s concerns to U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth at the ADMM-Plus in Cebu, with Mr. Hegseth reaffirming Washington’s support in combating cross-border terrorism

results.title: Cockroach Janta Party backs INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally
results.content: Invoking the principles of the Constitution and the legacy of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, the CJP said democracy depended on ensuring equal political representation and protecting every eligible citizen’s voting rights

results.title: India and Mexico sign Terms of Reference for preferential trade agreement negotiations to begin
results.content: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal visited Mexico for the signing. The two sides also discussed a possible business delegation from Mexico visiting India in the first quarter of 2027

results.title: AIKS calls off farmers’ march at Shahapur after talks with CM Fadnavis; government assures action on key demands
results.content: The meeting, held at Sahyadri Guest House in Mumbai, was attended by Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Pawar, senior ministers, government officials and an AIKS delegation

results.title: CSIR-NIIST showcases sustainable alternatives to conventional plastic packaging
results.content: CSIR-NIIST showcases bio-polymer bottle technology and biodegradable PBAT composites as sustainable alternatives to conventional plastic packaging at ESTIC 2026 conclave in New Delhi
